title: Weigh one decoder block
hints: KV cache holds a key and a value per head per layer: the leading factor is 2, then layers, heads, width, bytes.
Q and O use the query-head count; K and V use the KV-head count. The MLP is three matrices: gate, up, down.
An MoE token pays full attention plus only its active experts — two of eight for Mixtral, not eight.
